source: System Reference Document 5.1, Wizards of the Coast
compiledFrom: Cross-checked against 5e-bits/5e-database and open5e, both MIT-licensed for their own data structuring, resolved against the official SRD text where the two disagreed.
verificationNote: Conditions, Weapon Properties, Monsters, and Spells were individually cross-checked entry by entry against a second source (open5e), see BACKLOG #183 for the full pilot results. Equipment was individually cross-checked too, 6 flagged items, all resolved (5 already correct as vendored, 1 a unit-basis convention difference, not an error). Ability Scores, Skills, Magic Schools, Damage Types, Languages, Rules, and Rule Sections were migrated from the already-trusted, already-shipping vendored data with a lighter spot-check rather than a full pairwise diff against a second source, this is basic reference content (ability abbreviations, skill-to-ability pairings, damage type names) with a low realistic error rate, not complex multi-field stat blocks. Magic Items was migrated as-is too, the pilot found the earlier apparent disagreements were a comparison-methodology artifact, not real data errors, once matched correctly (5e-bits already flattens item variants into real separate entries, same as open5e does).
